variants.headline: Looking back: people leave the colony on the ship
variants.sub: The ship has taken away young adults with no work and families with no home.
variants.body:
We return to our earlier coverage. Our report recorded this: People have left the colony on the ship: young adults without work and families without homes.

The gazette records the departure and the stated circumstances of those leaving. A precise notice should distinguish the people who departed from assumptions about their destination or future intentions. The lack of work and homes belongs in the account without requiring an additional explanation not established by the report.

The event remains part of the record. Whether subsequent developments met the standard it raised is a separate question, not something the old headline can answer by itself.

The stewardship of {target} warrants scrutiny through the stated lack of work and homes. This paper records departure without assuming the destinations, hopes or future decisions of the people who have left.
